title: Initialize Search Boundaries
description: Set left pointer to the start of the array (index 0) and right pointer to the end of the array (index n-1). These define the current search interval.

title: Calculate Middle Index
description: Compute mid = left + (right - left) // 2. Using this formula instead of (left + right) // 2 prevents integer overflow in languages with fixed-size integers.

title: Compare with Target
description: Compare the element at index mid with the target value. Three outcomes are possible: equal (element found), less than target (search right half), or greater than target (search left half).

title: Update Search Interval
description: If target is greater than mid element: left = mid + 1 (discard left half). If target is less than mid element: right = mid - 1 (discard right half). This halves the search space each iteration.

title: Repeat or Return
description: Continue the process while left ≤ right. If left exceeds right, the target is not present in the array. Return the index of the found element, or -1 if not found.
